title: Quadruped embodiment × locomotion skill composition
hypothesis: Factorized per-embodiment and per-skill Givens views on a shared policy retain locomotion quality on held-out embodiment × speed pairs within 5% of a native condition-input policy payload and are not dominated by same-code-budget FiLM.

draw.eligible_rule: uniform P0 + UNTESTED IDs, excluding IDs with live remote origin/research/ma-* branches or pre-existing ma-* experiment directories

prior_art.rma_boundary: RMA already uses a shared policy with inferred extrinsics; this screen tests only factorized morphology × skill coordinates against native conditioning, not RMA adaptation or real robot transfer.
prior_art.morphology_world_model_boundary: Morphology-conditioned dynamics are prior art; no novelty claim is made for morphology conditioning itself.

simulator.simulator_source: Python 3.12; Gymnasium 1.4.0; MuJoCo 3.15.0; Ant MJCF SHA-256 cd5f83ef0ea35b0969e65d360c5bacd5b74ccaef6b27e4433b5168c605e3e2be (pinned source asset). Morphology MJCFs deterministically generated from this asset and hashed before demonstrations.
simulator.hardware: CPU only; no GPU and no physical robot
simulator.pair_split: Train/dev demonstrations only on pairs where (morphology_id + skill_id) mod 2 = 0; audit only on odd-parity pairs. Every morphology and every skill occurs in both partitions. No held-out pair demonstration is used for training or checkpoint selection.
simulator.domain_randomization: Only the four declared morphology parameter sets; randomized initial-state seed per episode. No undisclosed physics randomization.

teacher.type: deterministic phase-based torque controller used only to produce training targets
teacher.controller: Leg order is front-left, front-right, back-left, back-right. Skill phase offsets in radians are walk=[0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2], trot=[0,pi,pi,0], pace=[0,0,pi,pi], bound=[0,pi,0,pi]. For leg l, hip action=clamp(a*sin(phi+offset[l]),-1,1), ankle action=clamp(a*cos(phi+offset[l]),-1,1), with a=(0.45+0.4*target_speed)*actuator_scale and phase increment 2*pi*(1+1.5*target_speed)*dt. Map to MuJoCo actuator order [hip4,ankle4,hip1,ankle1,hip2,ankle2,hip3,ankle3]. Policy inputs include ant proprioception and sin/cos phase; test-time teacher access is prohibited.
teacher.tuning_boundary: Any teacher stability or amplitude adjustment uses development pairs and seeds only, is logged as an amendment before audit rollouts, and cannot inspect held-out pair scores.

models.common_policy: MLP with 2 hidden layers of width 128, ReLU, tanh action head, 8 torque outputs; all methods also receive the same two sinusoidal phase features.
models.native_conditioned: Common policy receives proprioceptive observation, phase features, four-dimensional morphology one-hot and four-dimensional skill one-hot.
models.no_code: Common policy receives proprioceptive observation and phase features only.
models.film: Observation/phase-only shared policy; learned 2D code for each morphology and each skill is projected through shared learned gamma/beta bases to first hidden width 128. Code begins N(0,0.02); bases begin N(0,0.02) to prevent a bilinear dead start.
models.mirror: Observation/phase-only shared policy; each morphology has 2 Givens angles and each skill has 2 Givens angles. Apply the two fixed pairwise rotations sequentially to hidden pairs (0,1) and (2,3) of the first hidden activation; no other private parameters.
models.independent_upper: Omitted: no training examples exist for the held-out pair-specific policies. Seen-pair specialists may be reported only as non-comparable diagnostics.

training.objective: behavior cloning MSE against teacher torques on train trajectories
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest mean development-pair action MSE; patience 150 validation checks at 20-update intervals
training.audit_tuning: No architecture, teacher, optimizer, checkpoint, or threshold changes after audit pair rollout metrics are read.

primary: audit mean normalized forward-speed tracking return
metrics.return_definition: Per step while upright: exp(-abs(vx-target_velocity)/max(target_velocity,0.15)) - 0.1*abs(vy) - 0.001*sum(action^2); after a fall, reward -1 for all remaining steps. Report episode mean and aggregate over held-out pairs/seeds.
metrics.structure_audit: Report each of eight held-out morphology × skill pairs separately and paired changes versus native and FiLM.
metrics.storage: Actual safetensors inference payload bytes, including policy, codes/bases and metadata needed to map morphology/skill IDs. Report shared model bytes, total registered state, per-pair reconstruction/download bytes, and ratio to the native one-policy condition-input control. Also report 16x native-policy bytes as a storage-only independent-bank reference, without using it as a quality comparator.
metrics.compute: Training examples, optimizer updates, action MAC proxy, CPU train wall time, MuJoCo rollout wall time, and measured policy batch-one latency.

gates.mirror_quality: Mean held-out return no more than 0.05 below native and fall fraction no more than 0.02 above native in at least 2/3 world seeds.
gates.storage: Mirror shared+registered factor state <=105% of native one-policy payload; per-pair factor download <=25% of an independently serialized policy. The native model itself is one shared conditioned policy; no 80%-of-native compression claim is preregistered.
gates.mirror_specificity: Mirror is not weakly Pareto-dominated by FiLM on held-out return, fall fraction, total payload bytes and measured adaptation/inference time.
gates.decision: PROMISING only if all gates pass; FAIL if a valid simulator/controller screen runs and a quality/storage gate fails; NOT ESTABLISHED if simulator, teacher stability, or control validity prevents a decision.

amendments.reason: Initial 80%-of-native storage gate was incompatible with the strongest native control, which is already a single shared conditioned policy. Before trajectory generation, replace with <=105% payload parity and report a 16-policy storage-only reference; do not use that reference for quality claims.

limitations: Synthetic morphology/speed grid and phase-controller teacher.
Behavior cloning and simulator rollouts are not RMA, PPO, real robot or safety evidence.
No claim of near-converged policy capacity; this is a fixed-data/fixed-update composition screen.
